title: Performance, Accessibility & Google Analytics Reporting Improvements
body:
- Enabled gzip compression in Nginx for faster JS, CSS, HTML, and SVG delivery.
- Added route-level code-splitting (React.lazy) so the homepage loads significantly less JavaScript.
- Improved mobile accessibility by removing viewport zoom restrictions and adding explicit image dimensions on homepage cards.
- Updated Google Analytics default analytics_storage to granted (keeping ad storage denied until CMP consent) so GA4 reports populate reliably.
